title: Eswatini LUCT CMS — FSD knowledge graph

nodes.label: Eswatini CMS
nodes.summary: LUCT Eswatini PHPMaker campus CMS under eswatini/campus/<desk>/, all desks sharing MySQL campus2_eswatini (legacy batch name swaziland). Mid-size LUCT sibling — 472 tables · 330 views · 53 SPs · 70 triggers. Assist codes ssb / limkokwing; no DTEF / TEF POST and no Lesotho NMDS.
nodes.raisd: M5 expansion reference, not ADR-1 SoR and not Lesotho M4. Prefer LUCT adapter patterns; CAP-53 campus key ESWATINI (portal_*_eswatini + legacy portal_student_swaziland).

nodes.label: Academic
nodes.summary: Registry, faculty, lecturer and CDU (AQA) desks around student master, programmes, modules, attendance and results.

nodes.label: Student life
nodes.summary: Services (visa, insurance, welfare), accommodation and noticeboard. Thick services desk (~341 PHP); accommodation (~198 PHP) thicker than Sierra Leone.

nodes.label: Commercial
nodes.summary: Marketing intake (app_*) and bursary ledger with assist billing (ssb / limkokwing). No r_scholarshipapp / TEF government POST in this dump.

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.summary: Setup (institution, terms, fee catalogs, user levels), reporting, eswatinibatch ops scripts, api_* / portal_*_eswatini hooks, plus AdBeConnect / IH / zemail ancillaries.

nodes.label: registry/
nodes.summary: Student master, personal/contact, offer letters and forms (~421 PHP — largest desk).
nodes.raisd: Student + Staff portals via Portal API; registry remains SoR for Eswatini.

nodes.label: faculty/
nodes.summary: Schools, programmes, modules, timetable, attendance and results (~332 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Student / Lecturer / Staff academic surfaces read through Portal API.

nodes.label: lecturer/
nodes.summary: Lecturer screens for marks, attendance and module materials (~167 PHP).

nodes.label: cdu/
nodes.summary: AQA / programme accreditation desks (~168 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff surface for programme approvals evidence.

nodes.label: services/
nodes.summary: Visa, insurance and welfare operations (~341 PHP — second-largest after registry).
nodes.raisd: Staff Services surface; student visa view via Portal API.

nodes.label: accommodation/
nodes.summary: Rooms, occupants and accommodation charges (~198 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Accommodation request UX (student) and staff housing desk.

nodes.label: notice/
nodes.summary: Bulletin / noticeboard (~86 PHP).

nodes.label: marketing/
nodes.summary: Applications and recruitment (~242 PHP). Same app_* naming as Cyberjaya / Botswana (11 app_* tables).

nodes.label: bursary/
nodes.summary: Invoices, payments, receipts and assist / scholarship billing (~353 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Student Finance read + Staff Bursary via Portal API.

nodes.label: Assist ssb / limkokwing
nodes.summary: Campus-local sponsorship via r_assistprovider / r_assistscheme* and b_assistbilling*. Procedure / scheme literals include assist codes ssb and limkokwing. Not Lesotho nmds, not Botswana DTEF → tef.gov.bw. No r_scholarshipapp in this dump.
nodes.raisd: Campus feature flag for assist codes. Do not invent NMDS or TEF clients for Eswatini.

nodes.label: setup/
nodes.summary: Institution, terms, fee catalogs and user levels (~303 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Campus configuration input for CAP-53 campus keying (ESWATINI).

nodes.label: reporting/
nodes.summary: Population, enrolment, payment and scholarship reports (~258 PHP).

nodes.label: eswatinibatch
nodes.summary: Ops scripts (not committed) refreshing portal, registry, bursary, examination and billing slices — swazilandbatchnight.sh + logs.
tables: portal · registry · bursary · examination · billing slices
nodes.raisd: Replace with campus-keyed Portal API sync at M5.

nodes.label: api_* / portal_* hooks
nodes.summary: api_student_* / api_faculty_* stored procedures and portal_*_eswatini tables (+ legacy portal_student_swaziland) feed external clients today. Pack also includes eswatini/api-service/.
nodes.raisd: Candidate read surface for future Portal API ACL — CAP-53 key ESWATINI.

nodes.label: AdBeConnect/
nodes.summary: Adobe Connect–style desk folder present in the dump (ancillary).
nodes.raisd: Out of Raisd portal scope unless a future staff surface needs it.

nodes.label: r_student
nodes.summary: Shared student record hub in campus2_eswatini. Registry/marketing enrol; faculty, bursary, lecturer, services and accommodation attach to it. Local scratch mirrors include gb_* and swa_sem1…swa_sem6.
nodes.raisd: Identity and enrolment source for campus-keyed Portal API reads.

nodes.label: Portal API
nodes.summary: Raisd anti-corruption layer. Applicant, student, lecturer and staff portals call only the Portal API; it reaches campus2_eswatini campus-keyed at M5+.
nodes.raisd: CAP-53 campus key ESWATINI; owns assist/sponsor adapters — never browser → CMS secrets.
